name: Setup Wizard servo type: default type once per wizard, a hand-set rate is kept
step: Check that the servo type step applies a group's default type once and keeps a hand-set rate on later visits
rationale:
The servo type step rebuilt its groups on every entry, so the flag that marks a group as opened reset each time,
and a group with a hand-set update rate was rewritten to its first type on every visit, with a restart owed. A narrow
servo at 400 Hz became mid 1520.

The harness loads the real setup_wizard_servotype.lua with the real heli helpers and a wizard stand-in, and pins: the
module loads at all (a broken line once passed CI because nothing loaded the file), the first visit applies the default
type, a rate set by hand afterwards is kept on the next visit in the same wizard, and a new wizard session applies the
default again.

--self-test forgets the applied groups on every visit and requires the kept-rate check to go red.
